reviews.text: I contacted them mainly to try and address some of Tyrion's behavior when we left home. Helga came to our house, and honestly, the guidelines she gave us from day one made a huge difference in Tyrion's behavior 🐶. We're so happy! She's incredibly responsible, dedicated, and has a real love for animals. I recommend her 100%. She also gave us additional tips during our walk and for neutral corrections at home, which were incredibly helpful!

Grateful to have met them... we adopted Zeus when he was two months old, and like any puppy, he was giving us a bit of trouble. It was becoming difficult to leave him alone at home because he was breaking things and also picking up some behaviors we wanted to correct, and walks were becoming difficult. I contacted German because of the good reviews they had, and we weren't wrong. I'm grateful to Helga, who, with so much love and dedication, has helped us immensely, giving us so many guidelines and tips, always listening to our needs, always using positive reinforcement, and with that love for dogs that characterizes her. That's why Zeus gets so happy every time he sees her. They have taught us so much, and without a doubt, from the very first session, we have been incredibly grateful because the changes have been significant. Thank you so much for the work you do and thank you so much for the help you have given us. Without a doubt, both Zeus and we are incredibly grateful for the great transformation we have experienced.

I was absolutely delighted with them. Helga came to our house to work with our dog, Simba. He was having some issues when he was left alone and was having a terrible time, but with the guidance she gave us, it was resolved incredibly quickly. Besides his separation anxiety, she also gave us tips on how to be more relaxed in other aspects of Simba's life, and all of this in just three sessions. Germán was also excellent in coordinating the sessions and everything else.

In short, I would recommend them 100%.
Thank you so much, guys, from Patri and our dog, Simba.

I contacted Germán and Helga because I'd already tried other trainers without success. My dog ​​has issues with insecurity and reactivity around people, and living with him was becoming difficult. I noticed improvement from the very first session, and in just three sessions, he's made tremendous progress. Helga gave us tips that were best suited to him and our environment, always respecting the dog and using positive reinforcement. My case was complex, and I know there's still work to be done, but I'm so grateful for their professionalism and my dog's improvement. I highly recommend them!

A round of applause for Helga! We adopted a puppy and needed guidance, both for his well-being and our own peace of mind. From day one, we noticed the results and couldn't be happier. At five months old, we have a happy and well-balanced puppy, as good as he is. I recommend her 100%.

Helga has been very professional with Kira. Her care and patience with our 11-month-old Brittany Spaniel has led to changes in her behavior. With the guidelines she gave us in two sessions, we will work to gradually achieve the goals we set. Now it's up to the whole family to work together. We've seen very positive progress in this time; there's still work to be done, but we have no doubt about the results. If we need support again, we would definitely call Helga because Kira and her family were delighted with her work. She is very professional. Thank you for your help!

Helga has been a wonderful trainer! In just 3 sessions, my 6kg dog, who has quite a few aggressive and insecure behaviors, has changed tremendously. She gave us lots of guidance, and now the work and consistency are up to us! We are so grateful! 🤩 …

I have a Malinois puppy and I'm very happy with his progress; they're very professional.
So far we've had three sessions and the dog has improved a lot, thanks to their help and the confidence they've instilled in us. I've decided to extend the sessions so my puppy can be even more obedient. 100% recommended.

I'm delighted with Arancha; she's given me great tips for my 10-month-old dog, Nala. She's a very good dog, but a little impulsive with certain stimuli, which we're gradually correcting thanks to Arancha's advice and help. Very useful lessons. Thank you!
Thanks to Ecanval, our dog is gradually overcoming his frustration with separation anxiety; thank you for the advice.

The experience with German and Arantxa has been excellent. They are both very professional and attentive throughout the entire process. Arantxa has helped us a lot with training our dog and understanding many of the behaviors he showed at home. Without a doubt, we've noticed that Galo has improved in many ways, and although we still have more work to do with him, we are very happy with the sessions we had with Arantxa. We highly recommend their services :)
These educators are top-notch. They've taught me how to understand and manage Khai's emotions. They answer all my questions and make everyday life much easier.

We have a 2-year-old German Shepherd, and our problem is that he pulls a lot on the leash and barks a lot at other dogs on walks. Arantxa came to our house and showed us how to correct the pulling with a training leash, and also how to correct the barking at other dogs. Ron, our dog, is stubborn, but little by little he's coming around, and we hope to be able to enjoy walks very soon. Thank you so much to Germán and Arantxa for helping us 🙏 Highly recommended.

I feel terrible, but it hasn't helped us at all. Arantxa, the trainer, is lovely, but Germán, the owner, told us that the problem would be solved in two sessions, and not only has it not been solved, it's gotten worse. Our dog was urinating in the house, had separation anxiety, and was pulling in the street. For the urination, we were told to put his food on the floor where he was urinating so he would associate it with not being a place to relieve himself. Now the dog eats and urinates at the same time. We switched to feeding him in his bowl because putting him on the floor is unhygienic; he eats and urinates in the bowl... we don't even have time to take him outside. The same thing happened with the anxiety; we were told to give him a space of his own with his toys, everything set up so he would see it as a safe place... we made the transition, and it's worse. He barks at the window and whines, and he also scratches at the door, which he didn't do before. The dog was pulling on the leash in the street, and we were told to buy a corrective collar. With the collar, the dog was scared, but without it, he "feels free," pulls more, and even tries to jump on people. It was a terrible experience; we wasted 180 euros and the dog hasn't improved at all. We were told he would be socialized with other dogs, but we didn't get it done.

I contacted them because my dog ​​was chasing everything that moved (bikes, skates, runners...) and I couldn't let her off-leash in large parks. They showed me some guidelines and solved the problem in just two sessions. Now walks in the parks are very pleasant. I recommend them 100%.

We are so happy to have found Ecanval to solve the problems we're having with our dog. We're especially pleased with the methods they use and the work Arantxa is doing to teach us how to train our mastiff.

We still have work ahead of us and a lot of perseverance required, but the sessions are proving incredibly helpful in learning how to work with him. We are very grateful for their work and highly recommend them!
A true professional, my dog ​​friend loved it...

I contacted them about my two German Shorthaired Pointers, and their service was incredibly quick and efficient. They adapt to your needs in every way. The trainer, Arantxa, is a true professional and an excellent person with animals. She helped us immensely throughout the entire process, and we are very grateful for her support and assistance. 100% recommended! 😋

If I had to recommend any trainers, it would be them. Super professional, they treat animals wonderfully, and they identify and address the problem very well. I'm delighted with the service and the great work they've done with my dog. A 10 out of 10!

We're very happy with Arancha. Following her guidance, our dog has improved in a short time. She's a true professional, and it's clear she enjoys her work. Don't hesitate to call her to help your furry friends.
Arantxa is super nice and very professional. Now it's time to put everything into practice! 😊 …
Arantxa gave us lots of tips to improve our dog's behavior, we're very happy ☺️
Great professionals

Wonderful! He's definitely a true professional. He treats the dogs with so much love and gives them great walks. Whenever I leave my dogs with him, it gives me so much peace of mind because I know they're in good hands and having a wonderful time. He also always sends photos and videos so you can see how much fun they're having. In short, he's fantastic!

I contacted Ecanval, desperate because of my two dogs' separation anxiety. They are senior dogs, and other trainers told us it would take a long time to see any changes.
From the first visit, Arantxa inspired a lot of confidence in us and explained everything in great detail and with patience. She is a super professional, attentive, and dedicated trainer. We started implementing some techniques, and within a week, we noticed an improvement. The second visit focused on walks, and the experience was also very positive and very patient. I'm truly hopeful that walks will become enjoyable again and that we can leave the house with peace of mind.

I definitely recommend them.

Bali is 7 months old and went on his first hike today. Germán was super punctual both when we left and when we arrived. He even sent us photos and videos of the day, which put our minds at ease. Bali is very tired but HAPPY! He had a fantastic time!
Thank you so much for the feedback, Edu. We're happy to help! 🦮 …

We're treating a dog with separation anxiety who was abandoned three times. We know it will be a long process, but we've been given many tools to cope, and little by little we're seeing positive changes. Thank you so much!

We definitely noticed a huge difference from day one! We couldn't go for walks with our little one, and from the very first day, the change was incredible. That said, you have to follow the guidelines exactly to see the difference and …

We're thrilled with Arantxa! After just the first session, we noticed a huge change in our pet's behavior, and now we just need to put what we learned in the second session into practice. Definitely 10/10.
